title: graph-types: always-true FieldTest serializes as {}
description:
graph-types: Expression::to_value turns an always-true FieldTest into an $eq {} test (batch 8b review, JMAP-ef3q.7).

crate-jmap-graph-types/src/search.rs:182 documents FieldTest::default() (no operators) as "always true", but FieldTest::to_value emits `{}`. Per draft-atwood-jmap-graph-search-00 L185-186, an operator object needs at least one `$` member, and "Any other value is shorthand for {"$eq": value}", so `{}` means $eq {}. Expression::parse turns it back into FieldTest::equal_to(json!({})), which matches only fields equal to an empty object. A caller who builds Expression{fields: {"/x": FieldTest::default()}} and sends to_value() gets a narrower filter than it built, silently. The to_value doc (L351-355, "keeps its meaning") does not hold here.

Fix: omit operator-less FieldTests from to_value (the wire has no always-true field test, and dropping the member preserves AND semantics), or reject them; add a parse(to_value(x)) round-trip test against hand-written spec JSON.
close_reason: Batch 9: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at df7e2035
